name: Hydrogen gas
description: Single bond; the lightest molecule.

name: Oxygen gas
description: Double bond; the gas you breathe.

name: Nitrogen gas
description: Triple bond makes it very unreactive; most of air.

name: Chlorine gas
description: Single bond; toxic yellow-green gas used to disinfect.

name: Ozone
description: Bent; absorbs UV high in the atmosphere.

name: Water
description: Bent, 104.5°. Hydrogen bonds give it a high boiling point.

name: Hydrogen peroxide
description: Has an O–O single bond; a mild oxidizer.

name: Carbon dioxide
description: Linear. The polar bonds cancel, so the molecule is nonpolar.

name: Carbon monoxide
description: Triple bond; binds hemoglobin and blocks oxygen transport.

name: Methane
description: Tetrahedral, 109.5°; the main part of natural gas.

name: Ammonia
description: Trigonal pyramidal; the nitrogen lone pair makes it a base.

name: Hydrogen chloride
description: Dissolves in water to make hydrochloric acid, a strong acid.

name: Hydrogen fluoride
description: Strong hydrogen bonding; a weak acid in water.

name: Hydrogen sulfide
description: Bent; smells like rotten eggs.

name: Sulfur dioxide
description: Bent; a cause of acid rain.

name: Nitrogen dioxide
description: Bent brown gas with an unpaired electron.

name: Sulfuric acid
description: Strong diprotic acid; the most-produced industrial chemical.

name: Nitric acid
description: Strong acid and oxidizer.

name: Phosphoric acid
description: Triprotic acid found in colas and fertilizers.

name: Sodium chloride
description: Table salt; sodium gives up one electron to chlorine.

name: Potassium chloride
description: Ionic salt and a key electrolyte.

name: Lithium fluoride
description: Ionic with a very high lattice energy.

name: Magnesium oxide
description: Mg²⁺ and O²⁻ ions; very high melting point.

name: Calcium oxide
description: Quicklime, made by heating limestone.

name: Sodium oxide
description: Basic oxide that reacts with water to form a base.

name: Aluminum oxide
description: Protective layer on aluminum; also the mineral corundum.

name: Iron(III) oxide
description: Rust and the ore hematite.

name: Zinc oxide
description: Used in sunscreen.

name: Copper(II) oxide
description: Black solid formed when copper is heated in air.

name: Magnesium chloride
description: One Mg²⁺ balances two Cl⁻ ions.

name: Calcium chloride
description: Road de-icer and drying agent.

name: Calcium fluoride
description: The mineral fluorite.

name: Silver chloride
description: Insoluble white solid that precipitates from solution.

name: Sodium hydroxide
description: Strong base made of Na⁺ and OH⁻ ions.

name: Potassium hydroxide
description: Strong base used in soap making.

name: Calcium carbonate
description: Limestone, chalk and seashells.

name: Sodium bicarbonate
description: Baking soda; a mild base.

name: Ammonium chloride
description: Salt of ammonia and hydrochloric acid.

name: Silicon dioxide
description: Network solid: quartz and sand.

name: Methanol
description: The simplest alcohol.

name: Ethanol
description: The alcohol in drinks; the –OH group allows hydrogen bonding.

name: Acetic acid
description: Weak acid that makes vinegar sour.

name: Ethane
description: All single bonds.

name: Ethene
description: Has a C=C double bond; planar.

name: Ethyne
description: Has a C≡C triple bond; linear.

name: Propane
description: A common fuel gas.

name: Benzene
description: Aromatic ring with delocalized electrons.

name: Glucose
description: The main fuel for cells; made in photosynthesis.

name: Sucrose
description: Table sugar: glucose joined to fructose.
